analysis:
Only base-side text of CHANGELOG.md was supplied (lines 1-201 and 202 onward). No head text or patch hunks were included, so I could not see what the PR adds or changes. CHANGELOG.md is documentation and has no runtime effect. I found nothing in the base text that is a regression, and I cannot rule out one in the unseen head content.

The base text records security-relevant behaviour that the threat model already covers:
- App Attest protocol 3 only (TB-011, T-052..T-058).
- Attestation challenges that fail closed (T-036).
- Removal of the unauthenticated provider-earnings lookup (T-031).
- The SSD prefix-cache TTL raised to 30 minutes, recorded as the SEC-035 re-acceptance (T-041).
- The public attestation roster excluding private-only providers (T-058).

The next pass should read the actual head diff of CHANGELOG.md for new claims that need threat-model updates. Examples: TTL or write-budget changes beyond what T-041 records, such as the SSD write budget raised to 750 GB/day. Other examples: Autopilot live control, bank payout migration, and a new advisory-review workflow that sends code to OpenRouter. The changelog entries are descriptive. I did not check any claimed code behaviour against source, because none was supplied.
